name: What is a curbless shower and what are its main advantages?
description: A curbless shower is a barrier-free shower design offering accessibility and a modern aesthetic. Key benefits include ease of access and an open bathroom feel.

mainEntity.name: What is a curbless shower and what are its main advantages?

acceptedAnswer.text: A curbless shower features a seamless entry without a raised threshold, making it level with the bathroom floor. Its primary advantages include improved accessibility for all ages and mobility levels, a modern aesthetic, and an open, spacious feel in the bathroom. For Hometelligent Inc., planning involves a precise subfloor modification and proper waterproofing to ensure effective drainage and prevent water migration beyond the shower area.
